title: Why Chopping Onions Makes You Cry
caption:
Onions literally make acid in your eyes. Here's why.
A cartoon chef chops onions like a professional, then bursts into tears as green gas swirls around his face, and finally keeps chopping wearing a snorkel mask.
Cutting onions releases propanethial S-oxide gas; it mixes with the moisture in your eyes to form a mild acid, so your eyes flood with tears to flush it out.
Do onions make you cry, or have you found a trick that actually works?
Save this before dinner prep and follow for more everyday body science.
